select pwd.delivery_id from wave_list as pw left join wave_list_detail as pwd on pw.id = pwd.main_id and pwd.is_deleted = false where pw.is_deleted = false and pw.code ${sql}

SELECT pw.ID, pwd.delivery_id, sbd.status FROM wave_list AS pw LEFT JOIN wave_list_detail AS pwd ON pw.ID = pwd.main_id AND pwd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery AS sbd ON sbd.ID = pwd.delivery_id AND sbd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pw.is_deleted = FALSE AND pw.status IN ( 'awaitPick', 'pickIng' )
AND pw.ID in(SELECT main_id FROM wave_list_detail WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId})
ORDER BY pw.ID
